mods.name: Really Fast Paintings
mods.description: Converts paintings into non-ticking block-backed decorations for improved performance.

releases.notes:
# Really Fast Paintings v2.0.0

Minecraft 26.3 release for Fabric.

- Updated painting placement, persistence, rendering, and metadata for Minecraft 26.3.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer for 26.3, and Java 25.
- Keeps Distant Decorations 2.0.0 optional. Its published Modrinth artifact supplies the compile API.
- Added client GameTests that enter a world, render a 2×2 painting, and exercise Distant Decorations record delivery and distant render submission.

Validation: clean build, 72 unit tests, 26 server GameTests, and client GameTests with and without Distant Decorations passed. Distant render submission was observed after the live painting chunk unloaded; the distant painting was not visually distinguishable in the captured screenshot, so far visual appearance remains unverified.

[Changes since v1.1.0](https://github.com/justbecauseph/really-fast-paintings/compare/v1.1.0...v2.0.0)
